requirements.subject: ent:top-level-definition
requirements.canonical: A top-level module definition HAS a visibility.
requirements.original: Top-level module definitions and import statements have a visibility, which can be explicitly set.

requirements.subject: ent:import-statement
requirements.canonical: An import statement HAS a visibility.
requirements.original: Top-level module definitions and import statements have a visibility, which can be explicitly set.

requirements.subject: ent:visibility
requirements.canonical: The visibility of a top-level module definition or an import statement MAY be set explicitly by a visibility modifier.
requirements.original: Top-level module definitions and import statements have a visibility, which can be explicitly set.

requirements.subject: ent:top-level-definition
requirements.canonical: A top-level module definition without an explicit visibility modifier IS public by default, except for imported definitions and friend definitions.
requirements.original: They are by default public except for imported and friend definitions.

ambiguity.issue: 'friend definitions' (definitions with explicit friend visibility) cannot be default-public, since their visibility is explicit; the exception is redundant and the term is not defined.

requirements.subject: ent:import-statement
requirements.canonical: An import statement without an explicit visibility modifier IS private by default.
requirements.original: Import definitions are by default private.

ambiguity.issue: 'Import definitions' is used for import statements; elsewhere 'import statement' and 'imported definition' are used.

requirements.subject: ent:friend-definition
requirements.canonical: A friend definition IS private only.
requirements.original: Friend definitions are private only.

readings: A friend module declaration (friend module X) SHALL only have private visibility.
A definition with friend visibility IS not importable by non-friend modules (i.e. private towards them).
ambiguity.issue: Chosen reading: 'friend definitions' denotes friend module declarations (clause 8.2.4), which can only be private. The term is undefined and could be confused with definitions having friend visibility.

requirements.subject: ent:group
requirements.canonical: A group definition IS public only.
requirements.original: Group definitions are public only.

requirements.subject: ent:group
requirements.canonical: A group definition SHALL NOT be declared with `friend` or `private` visibility.
requirements.original: Group definitions are public only.

requirements.subject: ent:visibility
requirements.canonical: A visibility modifier HAS the syntax [ `public` | `friend` | `private` ], i.e. it is optional and is one of the keywords `public`, `friend` or `private`.
requirements.original: [ public | friend | private ]

requirements.subject: ent:visibility
requirements.canonical: The visibility of a top-level definition or an import statement CONTROLS whether it is importable by another module.
requirements.original: The visibility controls whether a top-level definition or an import statement is importable by another module.

requirements.subject: ent:visibility
requirements.canonical: The visibility of a top-level definition or an import statement IS one of three visibilities: public, friend or private.
requirements.original: Three visibilities are distinguished:

requirements.subject: ent:public-modifier
requirements.canonical: A top-level definition or an import statement with public visibility IS importable by any other module.
requirements.original: A top-level definition or an import statement with public visibility is importable by any other module.

requirements.subject: ent:friend-modifier
requirements.canonical: A top-level definition or an import statement with friend visibility IS importable by friend modules only.
requirements.original: A top-level definition or an import statement with friend visibility is importable by friend modules only (see clause 8.2.4).

requirements.subject: ent:private-modifier
requirements.canonical: A top-level definition or an import statement with private visibility SHALL NOT be imported by any other module.
requirements.original: A top-level definition or an import statement with private visibility cannot be imported at all.

requirements.subject: ent:referenced-definition
requirements.canonical: When an importable definition is imported, all information of referenced definitions necessary for the usage of the importable definition IS imported together with it, even if a referenced definition is private.
requirements.original: NOTE: As specified in restriction e) of clause 8.2.3.1, this means that importable definitions are imported together with all information of referenced definitions that are necessary for the usage of the importable definition, even if the referenced definition is private.

requirements.subject: ent:identifier
requirements.canonical: The identifier of a private referenced definition IS NOT visible in the importing module.
requirements.original: Only the identifier of the referenced definition is not visible in the importing TTCN-3 module.

requirements.subject: ent:group
requirements.canonical: The visibility of a group IS always public.
requirements.original: The visibility of groups is always public.

requirements.subject: ent:imported-definition
requirements.condition: no visibility modifier is given for the import statement
requirements.canonical: The visibility of an imported definition IS private by default.
requirements.original: The visibility of imported definitions is by default private.

readings: An import statement without visibility modifier is private, so the definitions imported by it are not re-exported.
An imported definition itself carries a private visibility in the importing module.
ambiguity.issue: Visibility applies to import statements (s003, table 10); chosen reading: the imported definitions are by default not re-importable from the importing module, as the import statement is private.

requirements.subject: ent:module-definition
requirements.canonical: A module definition other than a group or an imported definition IS public by default.
requirements.original: All other module definitions are by default public.

requirements.subject: ent:visibility
requirements.canonical: The visibility of a top-level definition or an import statement DEFINES its importability by another module.
requirements.original: The visibility of a top-level definition or an import statement defines their importability by another module.

requirements.subject: ent:group
requirements.canonical: Membership of a top-level definition or an import statement in a group IS NOT affecting the importability of that definition.
requirements.original: If the top-level definition or the import statement is part of a group, this has no effect on the importability of the module definition.

readings: Group membership never changes the visibility/importability of the definition (a private definition in a group is not imported by group import).
Group membership has no effect on direct import, but importability via group import is still governed separately.
ambiguity.issue: Chosen reading: the visibility of the definition alone determines importability, including via group import (consistent with table 9).

requirements.subject: ent:public-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with public visibility IS importable directly by a non-friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: public; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: yes; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:public-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with public visibility IS importable directly by a friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: public; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: yes; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:public-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with public visibility IS importable via group import by a non-friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: public; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: yes; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:public-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with public visibility IS importable via group import by a friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: public; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: yes; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:friend-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with friend visibility IS NOT importable directly by a non-friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: friend; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:friend-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with friend visibility IS importable directly by a friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: friend; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:friend-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with friend visibility IS NOT importable via group import by a non-friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: friend; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:friend-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with friend visibility IS importable via group import by a friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: friend; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: yes; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:private-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with private visibility IS NOT importable directly by a non-friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: private; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: no

requirements.subject: ent:private-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with private visibility IS NOT importable directly by a friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: private; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: no

requirements.subject: ent:private-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with private visibility IS NOT importable via group import by a non-friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: private; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: no

requirements.subject: ent:private-modifier
requirements.canonical: A module definition with private visibility IS NOT importable via group import by a friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of module definition: private; Module definition importable directly by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable directly by a friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a non-friend module: no; Module definition importable via group import by a friend module: no

requirements.subject: ent:public-modifier
requirements.canonical: An import statement with public visibility IS imported by a non-friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of import: public; Import imported by a non-friend module: yes; Import imported by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:public-modifier
requirements.canonical: An import statement with public visibility IS imported by a friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of import: public; Import imported by a non-friend module: yes; Import imported by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:friend-modifier
requirements.canonical: An import statement with friend visibility IS NOT imported by a non-friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of import: friend; Import imported by a non-friend module: no; Import imported by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:friend-modifier
requirements.canonical: An import statement with friend visibility IS imported by a friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of import: friend; Import imported by a non-friend module: no; Import imported by a friend module: yes

requirements.subject: ent:private-modifier
requirements.canonical: An import statement with private visibility IS NOT imported by a non-friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of import: private; Import imported by a non-friend module: no; Import imported by a friend module: no

requirements.subject: ent:private-modifier
requirements.canonical: An import statement with private visibility IS NOT imported by a friend module.
requirements.original: Visibility of import: private; Import imported by a non-friend module: no; Import imported by a friend module: no

requirements.subject: ent:control-part
requirements.canonical: The module control part IS a shorthand notation to define a module control function.
requirements.original: The module control part is a shorthand notation to define a module control function.

requirements.subject: ent:control-part
requirements.canonical: The module control part HAS the syntax `control` StatementBlock.
requirements.original: control StatementBlock

requirements.subject: ent:control-part
requirements.canonical: The module control part IS equivalent to a module control function with the same statement block, no parameters, no `runs on` clause and no `return` clause.
requirements.original: The shorthand notation is equivalent to a module control function with the same statement block, no parameters, no runs on clause and no return clause (see clause 16.1).

requirements.subject: ent:control-part
requirements.canonical: A TTCN-3 module CAN contain at most one module control part.
requirements.original: NOTE: As the control part is a short hand notation of a control function with the name "control", at most 1 control part can be defined in a TTCN-3 module.

readings: A module SHALL NOT contain more than one control part.
A module SHALL NOT contain both a control part and an explicitly declared function named control, nor more than one control part.
ambiguity.issue: The note derives the limit from the name clash; chosen the plain reading (at most one control part). Whether a control part plus an explicit control function is also forbidden is implied but not stated.

requirements.subject: ent:module-control-function
requirements.canonical: When not used as an entry point for test suite execution, a module control function CAN be invoked explicitly like a function, using the `control` keyword instead of an identifier.
requirements.original: When not used as an entry point for execution of the test suite, the module control function can be invoked explicitly in a similar way as a standard function, using the control keyword instead of the identifier.

requirements.subject: ent:control-keyword
requirements.canonical: In an explicit invocation of a module control function, the `control` keyword MAY be prefixed with a module identifier followed by a dot.
requirements.original: In this case, the control keyword may be optionally prefixed with a module identifier followed by a dot.

requirements.subject: ent:module-control-function
requirements.condition: the referenced module control function does not have any parameters
requirements.canonical: If the referenced module control function has no parameters, the parameter list MAY be omitted at the place of invocation.
requirements.original: If the referenced module control function does not have any parameters, the parameter list may also be omitted at the place of invocation.

ambiguity.issue: 'parameter list' at the invocation means the actual parameter list (the parentheses).
